query:
UPDATE claims 
SET 
  document_processing_status = 'uploaded',
  status = 'intake_pending',
  workflow_state = 'intake_queue',
  ai_assessment_triggered = 0,
  ai_assessment_completed = 0,
  pipeline_current_stage = NULL,
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id IN (6060001, 5850001)
  AND claim_number NOT LIKE 'TEST-%';
